subject: Sweep: dead completeModule (script-src+inline) across Forge applets
description: The <script src>+inline-body pattern that swallowed completeModule in the hard-drive applet (fixed f12eaf90f) is copy-pasted across sibling Forge applets — confirmed in peripheral_devices, likely more. Each means a silently-dead Complete Module button (ReferenceError, no completion/achievement). Grep _app/houses/*/applets for `<script src=...>` immediately followed by inline `function completeModule`, split each, and align the moduleId to the canonical registry id. Also fix any that write to GameTracker.js (wrong dep) instead of ModuleProgress. Ref: memory reference_forge_hub_completion_and_dead_button.
activeForm: Sweeping dead completeModule pattern across Forge applets
